message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法取得即時的市場行情。若您想知道今天美國市場上黃金的最新價格，建議您參考以下幾個可靠來源：

| 來源 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 提供即時行情、新聞與分析 |
| Reuters | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities | 具備全球貴金屬報價 |
| Kitco | https://www.kitco.com/ | 專門報導黃金、白銀等貴金屬價格 |
| London Bullion Market Association (LBMA) | https://www.lbma.org.uk/ | 官方黃金市場報價 |

這些網站通常會以「美元/盎司」為單位顯示黃金價格，並提供24小時更新。若您需要更精確的數字，請直接前往上述網站或使用金融資訊平台（如 Bloomberg Terminal、Reuters Eikon 等）查詢。

We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical gold price or mention that it's around $X per ounce. But we should be careful: we cannot provide inaccurate data. We can say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or the London Bullion Market Association. We can also provide a typical range. But the user likely wants the current price. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. We can provide a general answer: "As of the last available data, gold was trading at around $X per ounce." But we need to be careful not to mislead. We can say "I don't have real-time data, but you can check X." That is safe.

We can also mention that gold price is quoted in US dollars per troy ounce. Provide typical price range. But we should not give a specific number unless we have data. So we should respond with a disclaimer.

Thus: "I don't have real-time data. As of the last close, gold was around $X per ounce. For the most accurate price, check a reliable financial news source."
